Title: Get a 2017 Daily Dozen Recipe Calendar
Author: Michael Greger M.D. FACLM

Content.Html:
Today is #GivingTuesday, kicking off the charitable season with a celebration of giving and philanthropy. To commemorate it this year, we’ve created a 2017 Daily Dozen Recipe Calendar, with each month featuring a Green-Light recipe submitted by one of you! If your 2017 wall calendar doesn’t specify when National Kale Day is (October 5th, duh) then you have the wrong calendar! The first 150 people to donate $100 or more to keep the 501c3 nonprofit NutritionFacts.org alive and thriving will get a calendar in time for the new year. UPDATE: We are all out of calendars! Thank you so much for all your amazing support.

In this year of post-truth politics, it’s more important than ever to stand up for the science. A soda and dairy lobbyist has been tasked with helping set up the new Department of Agriculture, which sets nutrition policy and oversees the Dietary Guidelines for Americans. If a tobacco hack was setting up the Centers for Disease Control, what do you think they’d say about smoking?

So we may not be able to rely on the powers-that-be to deliver us lifesaving nutrition facts. If only there were some sort of website that could deliver the science directly… Please join me in supporting the evidence-based nutrition revolution! Donate now. 
 

We didn’t have gift cards… until now

Shopping for someone else but not sure what to give them? How about the gift of science with a DrGreger.org gift card (100% of proceeds go to NutritionFacts.org). Cards are available in three designs and come in denominations of $10, $25, $50, and $100. You can send them via e-mail or print them out and give them as a physical gift. Check them out here.

 

 

NutritionFacts.org Outreach Cards

Ever been in a situation where the subject of diet or disease came up and you wish there were a quick and easy way to help them cut through all the nonsense out there? Well now you can! Help spread the message of dietary sanity with our brand new business cards. The two-sided card design features information about NutritionFacts.org and How Not to Die with links to our social media. Share them with friends, colleagues, patients, or anyone else you think could benefit from life-saving nutritional science. They are available at cost here.

 

 

Help Wanted

Ever since I started NutritionFacts.org five years ago I’ve used the presentation software Keynote to create the videos (it’s kind of like the Mac version of Powerpoint). This is only because I didn’t have expertise in high-powered software like After Effects. To give the videos a more modern feel (while maintaining the professionalism) we’re considering working with someone skilled in these more advanced tools. There are lots of design companies and freelancers out there, but as a mission-driven organization we’d rather pay someone who’s passionate about this work. If that describes you, please submit a sample of your work here.

 

New Volunteer Positions

Volunteers keep NutritionFacts.org running! In addition to our usual roles for the Translations and Article Retrieval projects, we currently have several volunteer openings for writers, editors, Pinterest users, and tech support. For more information and to apply to help out, head to our volunteer opportunities page.

 

Live Q&A’s TODAY

Every month now I’m doing Q&A’s live from my treadmill, and today is the day!

  • Facebook Live: At noon ET Today go to our Facebook page to watch live and ask questions.
  • YouTube Live Stream: At 8pm ET Today go here to watch live and ask even more questions! 

 

 
I hope everyone had a wonderful Thanksgiving. I give thanks for you!

Michael Greger, M.D.
